The Defective Detective — Album 3: Serah Contemplates

Keemaro and Sons

"Keemaro and Sons Legacy polished bright"

[Verse] Brass on the door Marble floor Cases screened before they cross the board

Reception desk Private wings Three assistants just to schedule things

Keemaro and Sons Built long ago If the city needs a private eye Everybody knows where to go

No walk-ins No random pleas No “find my ex from ’93”

Every client vetted twice

Prestige has a waiting price

[Pre-Chorus] Hundreds on staff Files in rows Everybody knows exactly where everything goes

Keemaro built it Year by year

And retirement suddenly feels too near

Keemaro and Sons Top of every list

A name built carefully enough

That failure shouldn’t exist

Keemaro and Sons

…

Counts to five

Then compromises

“My sons.”

“Yes, Father.”

“I need one simple thing.”

Three faces brighten

This was his first mistake

[Pre-Chorus] “New detective.”

“Opened near our district.”

“Small operation.”

“Scope the place.”

“Observe.”

“Report.”

“Do not engage.”

Keeko writes

“Engage?”

Keemaro replies

“No.”

Keemaro and Sons Top of every list

A name built carefully enough

That failure shouldn’t exist

[Verse] Three sons cross the district line

Matching coats Absolutely not matching minds

They find the office

Line outside

Phone keeps ringing from inside

Foxxie talking Coda typing

Kamira disappears somewhere frightening

Nessa arguing near the sink

Andy carrying six drinks

Serah yelling,

“WHO TOUCHED MY FILES?”

Keeko whispers,

“Highly organized.”

[Pre-Chorus] Keewee says,

“I think the child’s the boss.”

Junior nods,

“The fox may be support staff.”

Keeko writes it down

Excellent

Research

[Chorus] Keemaro and Sons Field report underway Observe the competition

Try to understand their way

Keemaro and Sons Three investigators strong

If all three compare their notes

Surely nothing can go wrong

Surely

Nothing

Can go wrong

[Bridge] Back at headquarters

Keemaro waits

“Report.”

Keeko stands straight

“They’re extremely dangerous.”

Keemaro leans forward

“Why?”

“They have free coffee.”

…

Keewee adds,

“There’s a broadcasting cat.”

Junior mentions

“And a bathroom that glows red.”

Keemaro says

“The detective?”

Keeko answers

Keewee says

Junior reports

Silence

Page one Coffee inventory

Page two Tail count

Page three “Suspicious pink headphones”

Page four Bathroom lighting concerns

Page five A sketch of Andy

Labeled

LIKELY MANAGEMENT

Keemaro slowly lowers the report

[Pre-Chorus] “You were there for three hours.”

“Yes, Father.”

“And this is what you found?”

“Yes, Father.”

“Anything about their cases?”

Three sons look at each other

Keeko says,

“They appear to solve things.”

[Chorus] Keemaro and Sons Legacy polished bright Decades of cases Decades done right

Keemaro and Sons The name still carries weight

But Keemaro’s starting to understand

Inheritance may tempt fate

Keemaro and Sons

Which is unfortunate

For several reasons

[Final Chorus] Keemaro and Sons Still the finest in the trade Systems clean Standards high Every reputation made

Keemaro and Sons He has nothing yet to fear

One strange little office opening

Shouldn’t matter anywhere

Still

Keemaro keeps the report

Files it under

SERAH SOLVES

Not because he’s worried

Because good detectives

Watch everything

[Outro] Keeko asks,

“So are they rivals?”

Keewee replies

“I think they’re a café.”

Junior answers

“No, no.”

“A podcast studio.”

Keemaro looks through the office glass

At the agency he spent decades building

Then at his three sons

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“Go home.”

“All of you.”

Keeko asks “Excellent work?”

Keemaro looks at them and answers slowly

“No.”
